cues.en:
In Dimento, legend tells of a city cursed
by the ancient archmage Chu Lu Gah...
cues.note: Narrator establishes a local legend, not a verified historical account.

cues.en:
Long ago, Chu Lu Gah lost his way in this forest
and was attacked by monsters. He reached the city
half-dead, but its people offered him no aid.

Tormented by unbearable loneliness and despair,
Chu Lu Gah cried out with his dying breath...
"Let every last one of you taste my suffering!"
cues.note: Keep the full force of his curse.

cues.en:
Mist shrouded the city. The surrounding forest,
twisted by the curse, became a bewildering barrier
that cut the city off from the world.
It drew monsters in and became a vast labyrinth.

Some tried to find the city trapped by this curse.
But in time, interest faded. It came to be spoken of
as an ancient city, existing only in legend...

subtitle_segments.en:
In Dimento, legend tells of a city cursed
by the ancient archmage Chu Lu Gah...

Long ago, Chu Lu Gah lost his way in this forest
and was attacked by monsters.

He reached the city half-dead,
but its people offered him no aid.

Tormented by unbearable loneliness and despair,
Chu Lu Gah cried out with his dying breath...
"Let every last one of you taste my suffering!"

Mist shrouded the city.
The surrounding forest, twisted by the curse,

became a bewildering barrier
that cut the city off from the world.

It drew monsters in
and became a vast labyrinth.
Some tried to find the city trapped by this curse.

It came to be spoken of as an ancient city,
existing only in legend...
